$comment: Machine-readable desired state for the control repository's main-branch ruleset (ADR-0001). Verified against the live GitHub ruleset by scripts/verify-ruleset.mjs before every production release. No Terraform.
name: launchpad-main

rules.$comment: SOLO-OWNER MODE (intentional; do not flip without a reviewed policy change): the control repository has a single maintainer, so GitHub CODEOWNER approval is deliberately NOT enforced (required_approving_review_count=0, require_code_owner_review=false, require_last_push_approval=false). Compensating controls: no bypass actors including administrators, direct pushes banned (creation/deletion/non_fast_forward rules), stale reviews dismissed on push, required review-thread resolution, strict required status checks, and squash-only merges. Docs that still claim CODEOWNER approval (AGENTS.md, CODEOWNERS header, docs/guides/deployment.md, master plan 25/8.8) are drift to be aligned.
